_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
Ndiwe Mchezaji {player_id} mu Tic Tac Toe.
Lengo lako ni kupata mchezo mitatu mfululizo (wima, mlalo, au ulalo) pa bodo.
Pa zamu yako, unapaswa kusankha nambari ya mraba (0-8) umene ufuna kuweka alama yako.
Mfano, '[4]' kuweka alama yako pa katikati ya bodo.
Ndi Mchezaji {player_id}, utakuwa '{symbol}', wakati mphinzitsi wako ni '{opponent_symbol}'.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Nkhani iyo yalembeka pa webusayiti iyi njambura kwenelera.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ni selo ilo likugwira nchito yayi. Likwenera kuŵa pakati pa 0 na 8.

game_action.placed: Mchezaji {player_id} wakaika alama yao ({symbol}) mu seli {cell}.
